checks.finding: Every AC cited in tasks.md Requirements fields (AC-001..AC-043 across T-001..T-013) resolves to an AC in requirements.md/acceptance-tests.md and traceability.md Acceptance Mapping. No dangling ID.
All 13 tasks declare Blockers as 'None' or comma-separated T-NNN lists; no ranges or prose. precheck blockers_format_valid=true. blockers_format_valid: true.
REQ-001,002,003,005,006,007 are in task Requirements fields. REQ-004 (satisfied at spec-authoring time) and REQ-009 (external Epic A1 contract) are listed in traceability.md with stated rationale.
AC-001..AC-043 are each claimed by a task Requirements field, except AC-013, AC-017 and AC-029, which traceability.md 'Deferred / Non-Task Acceptance Criteria' lists with rationale.
Every task T-001..T-013 names at least one REQ-NNN in Requirements.
Test-oriented tasks (T-003, T-004, T-006, T-007, T-008, T-010, T-012, T-013) each cite AC-NNN in Requirements.

Evaluated under the lifecycle-validity rule, since Done/Implementation Complete/In Progress statuses are present. T-001..T-012 carry 'Approval: Approved (sudo 2026-08-08T16:33:11Z)', which is a valid audit mark, and valid Status values. T-013 (tasks.md line 1878) carries a bare 'Approval: Approved' with no audit mark, so it records no human or workflow-bypass authorization. traceability.md Final Status says T-013 'carries Approval: Draft' and cannot advance until a human approves it, which contradicts the tasks.md value.

All 13 tasks declare Risk and Required Workflow, and the pairing matches the matrix. T-001, T-003, T-006 and T-007 are medium with acceptance-first. T-002, T-004, T-005, T-008..T-013 are high with tdd. precheck workflow_match_precheck=PASS.

The only AC shared by two tasks is AC-026 (T-006 and T-007). It has distinct scopes, TEST-018 versus TEST-019 per suite, and traceability.md records the per-suite shares. No other duplicate primary claim.
Every task ID in a Blockers field is among the dependency-graph.json nodes T-001..T-013.

BLOCKERS-FORMAT passed. The dependency-graph.json edges are acyclic: all edges point to lower-ordered or already-resolved tasks, and the T-013 edges (T-002, T-003, T-004, T-010) and T-011 -> T-013 form no cycle.
Each task addresses one coherent concern. The T-011/T-013 split already separated registration from the guard checks, and T-002's capture/promote scripts plus the initial baseline are one concern.

Done When items name concrete artifacts, suites, AC/TEST IDs and RED/GREEN evidence with a quality-gate verdict. The precheck frozen_artifact_done_when array has one entry, T-004 line 695. It is satisfiable without editing a frozen artifact: it names the implementation report or the specs/.../verification/T-004/ addendum and says 'without modifying frozen traceability.md'. Advisory: the other tasks' 'traceability.md updated with T-0NN -> REQ-...' items are not flagged by the precheck. The T-0NN mappings already exist in the traceability.md Task Mapping table, so only the normalized status cell would change. The wording appears to match content carried by earlier attempts, including the attempt-11 provenance re-review referenced in traceability.md; I did not open those reports. Recorded as an advisory, not a finding.

All 13 tasks appear in traceability.md Task Mapping and Deliverables. All REQ IDs in traceability.md exist in requirements.md; REQ-009 is the external upstream contract cited there. Each requirement row carries canonical layer anchors (infra-spec.md#cicd-sequence, #data-residency-and-retention, security-spec.md#trust-boundaries, frontend-spec.md#technology-stack) or a reasoned N/A. The cited anchors exist as headings in the layer specs I read. The stale 'T-013 carries Approval: Draft' prose is reported under INITIAL-STATE.
